newsitem.title: UK: India buys 135,000t April diesel, trade estimates.
newsitem.headline: India buys 135,000t April diesel, trade estimates.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) appears to have bought about 135,000 tonnes of high speed diesel for April delivery, traders quoting preliminary indication of tender results said on Friday.
They said three cargoes of 45,000 tonnes had been awarded, two of 1.0 percent and one of 0.5 percent. But, they could not immediately give a price level.
"It's three cargoes, so that is not going to have an enormous impact," said one trader.
On Monday IOC bought by tender 570,000 tonnes of 1.0 percent sulphur diesel.
